This is Shiny without a server! Magic! This works because of [{shinylive}](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/index.html) and the [shinylive Quarto extension](https://quarto-ext.github.io/shinylive/).

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 700

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Load and clean data
penguins <- na.omit(penguins)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("🐧 Penguins! 🐧"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      selectInput(
        "variable",
        "Select numeric variable to visualize:",
        choices = c(
          "Bill length (mm)" = "bill_len",
          "Bill depth (mm)" = "bill_dep",
          "Flipper length (mm)" = "flipper_len"
        ),
        selected = "bill_len"
      ),
      
      sliderInput(
        "binwidth",
        "Histogram binwidth:",
        min = 1,
        max = 20,
        value = 2,
        step = 0.5
      ),
      
      hr(),
      h4("Filter data"),
      
      selectInput(
        "species",
        "Species:",
        choices = c("All", levels(penguins$species)),
        selected = "All"
      ),
      
      selectInput(
        "island",
        "Island:",
        choices = c("All", levels(penguins$island)),
        selected = "All"
      ),
      
      selectInput(
        "sex",
        "Sex:",
        choices = c("All", "male", "female"),
        selected = "All"
      ),
      
      hr(),
      helpText("Data from R's built-in penguins data | Palmer Station LTER")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      # plotOutput("histogram", height = "500px"),
      plotOutput("histogram"),
      h4("Summary statistics"),
      verbatimTextOutput("summary")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive data filtered by user selections
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    data <- penguins
    
    # Apply filters
    if (input$species != "All") {
      data <- data[data$species == input$species, ]
    }
    if (input$island != "All") {
      data <- data[data$island == input$island, ]
    }
    if (input$sex != "All") {
      data <- data[data$sex == input$sex, ]
    }
    
    data
  })
  
  # Render histogram
  output$histogram <- renderPlot({
    req(nrow(filtered_data()) > 0)
    
    variable_name <- switch(input$variable,
      "bill_len" = "Bill Length (mm)",
      "bill_dep" = "Bill Depth (mm)",
      "flipper_len" = "Flipper Length (mm)"
    )
    
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = .data[[input$variable]])) +
      geom_histogram(
        binwidth = input$binwidth,
        color = "white",
        boundary = 0
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Distribution of", variable_name),
        subtitle = if (input$species != "All" | input$island != "All" | input$sex != "All") 
          paste("Filtered by:", 
                if(input$species != "All") paste("Species:", input$species),
                if(input$island != "All") paste("Island:", input$island),
                if(input$sex != "All") paste("Sex:", input$sex)) else "All penguins",
        x = variable_name,
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray50")
      )
  })
  
  # Render summary statistics
  output$summary <- renderPrint({
    data <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(data) > 0)
    
    cat("Dataset size:", nrow(data), "penguins\n")
    cat("Selected variable:", 
        switch(input$variable,
               "bill_len" = "Bill Length",
               "bill_dep" = "Bill Depth",
               "flipper_len" = "Flipper Length"), 
        "\n")
    cat("----------------------------------------------------------\n")
    summary_stats <- summary(data[[input$variable]])
    print(summary_stats)
    cat("\n")
    cat("Standard deviation:", round(sd(data[[input$variable]], na.rm = TRUE), 2))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
